BiblicalUsage: To be over, left over, in excess — adaph is the word for what remains. He that gathered much manna "had nothing over"; the manna that "remaineth over" was kept for the Sabbath; and the remnant of the tabernacle curtains hung over the back of the tent. The word moves from the wilderness table to the house of God.
TheologicalSignificance: Leftovers are a plain fact of the manna story, and the provision is the teaching — he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack.
